This item argues the inbox caps are unreachable at this workspace size. Measured today, the **roadmap** active cap has a different and more mechanical reason for being unreachable, so a threshold change alone would not fix it.

**Measurement.** 14 active rows against a recommended maximum of 8. **So the cap is a leaf-count cap being applied to a subtree-inclusive count.** With five teams live and a four-deep DD-R hierarchy, an ancestor chain contributes one active row per level per lane, and no amount of cleanup removes them while the leaf below is live — marking an ancestor `pending` while its child is `active` produces the parent/child inversion the same command warns about (two already exist: `AJC.picrep` pending over an active `AJC.picrep.rational-point`; `AJCR.w5-av` pending over an active `AJCR.w5-av.t5`).
